⚠ RAC (Regeneration Audit Council) appears in all three lanes as the same institution — it is the GGF-level gatekeeping body for Pathfinder certification.
The enterprise system is deliberately designed to self-contain most disputes. DJT jurisdiction is triggered only by treaty-level violations (e.g. certification fraud at scale,
cross-border AI harms, or community harm meeting the ecocide threshold). The Annual Review & Adaptation Protocol provides a systemic, non-adversarial parallel channel.
Community & Ecology Review Panels evolve into Joint BAZ-Corporate Review Boards once BAZs become operational in a region.
